# Georgia Insider

> Bilingual (English/Russian) relocation and business advisory 
> service based in Tbilisi, Georgia. We help Russian-speaking 
> entrepreneurs and expats relocate to Georgia — banking, taxes, 
> company registration, legal services.

## Services
- Orientation consultation ($120) — banking, taxes, neighborhoods, business setup
- Soft Landing package ($350) — full first-week accompaniment
- Legal services — company registration, land plots, real estate
